content:
samir: Hey devex, hitting a weird flow on the quickstart sample app. First API call returns `402 Payment Required` even though I was invited and I have credits. Then the SDK retries 3x and we see duplicate request logs. Anyone seen this?

maria: Can you paste the root error payload and the SDK version? Also which workspace/org id is this?

samir: SDK: js @redwood/sdk v0.9.2, Node 18. Logs below:

```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
content-type: application/json

{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"workspace requires billing setup"}}
Retry 1 -> 402
Retry 2 -> 402
Retry 3 -> 402
```

Also the sample app prints `first_call_success` after the retries which is confusing (it looks successful client-side).

devon: We shipped a change in v0.9.2 that inadvertently maps billing 402 responses into a generic auth error internally, which triggers the auth retry logic. That would explain the retry loop and the weird client-side behavior.

kyra: From billing side, that `workspace requires billing setup` is explicit — invites don't always auto-enable trial for older orgs. Samir, what's your workspace slug? I can check flags.

samir: workspace slug is `samir-test-team`. org id: `org_01G3X2`. I thought invites auto-enabled trial for new workspaces?

kyra: There's a known migration bug for invites created before the trial flow change; the `trial_enabled` bit wasn't flipped. I can flip it for org_01G3X2 — give me ~5m.

infra-bot: Deploy queued: canary release v0.9.3 (patch) — rollback window 15m — change: "do not trigger auth retry on billing-required 402". CI: ✅.

devon: :thumbsup: We'll cut the patch and publish an npm patch release. In the meantime, local workaround: set env `REDWOOD_SDK_DISABLE_RETRY_ON_4XX=true` or use a service-account key (service accounts bypass invite gating) for local dev.

samir: Thanks — Kyra flipped the flag and after a restart I retried and got 200. Confirmed the sample app first call succeeds now.

maria: Great — I'll open a docs PR to call out the service-account workaround and the env var for local dev, and I'll file an internal issue to add a 402->retry telemetry alert.

kyra: Done — org org_01G3X2 is updated. I left a note in the billing dashboard and created billing-migration task for affected orgs.

samir: Closing loop — appreciate the fast help everyone :rocket:
